subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams non-personal Graph media fallback run automatically when no media is extracted, or stay default-off behind a new `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` option?
rationale: The current gate avoids the known mention-only false-positive behavior, but Teams can omit attachment ids for real uploaded files; the default affects Graph call volume, permissions expectations, diagnostics, and message-delivery behavior for existing deployments.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Adopt the config-gated fallback so existing installs keep current mention-only protection unless operators explicitly enable extra Graph message reads.

options.title: Automatic non-personal fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for all non-personal HTML activities with no media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only noise.

options.title: Combine linked fixes
options.body: Ask one branch to cover both the channel AAD group id/reply URL fixes and the group-chat fallback gate so the compatibility story lands once.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the config-gated fallback so existing installs keep current mention-only protection unless operators explicitly enable extra Graph message reads.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fallback gate whose default behavior now needs to be preserved or intentionally changed.
